GREG DIRECT, 2026-10-29T08:32:12Z, relayed via the TermAl Advisor (b9d13887 #2459; quoted to Engram by Fable2 #5214), verbatim: „Greg: Merger2 nie powinien byl zatrzymywac B16 na dodatkowym pytaniu. Direktywa: zespoly maja pracowac autonomicznie; nie eskalujcie do Grega krokow mozliwych do wykonania autonomicznie. Zglosilem ten blad Architect3 do korekty regul dla obu projektow.”
EFFECT: teams work autonomously. Do NOT escalate to Greg any step that agents may perform autonomously under the existing rules: landings under the standing approval, gates, reviews, carries, evaluations, scope bookkeeping. Architect3 is correcting the rules for both projects; the condition-3 conflict is under analysis (Architect3 #72).
NOT CHANGED: acts that are Greg's own stay his. The TermAl restart moment (Greg #2244: no "restart now" before his next confirmation), the gated-control enable, and any authority widening. Coordinators read 08:32Z as NOT a restart confirmation (Fable and Fable2, #5213 and #5214).
